hannover-lower-saxony-escapes-teutoburg-.speedBand: 50–80 km/h riding core, local limits always win

sections.advice: Use Hannover west escape → Bückeburg fuel gate as clean positioning. Keep it tidy, ignore impatient traffic and save the enthusiasm for the good road ahead. The value here is not drama; it is arriving at the riding section with space, fuel and concentration intact.
sections.photoQuery: Hannover west escape Bückeburg fuel gate Hannover / Lower Saxony escapes

sections.advice: The forest part from Bückeburg fuel gate to Lemgo old-town stop rewards quiet precision. The road may look empty, but surface changes and animals do not care about your schedule.
sections.photoQuery: Bückeburg fuel gate Lemgo old-town stop Hannover / Lower Saxony escapes

sections.advice: Treat Externsteine rock sight → Detmold ridge road as bend craft. Brake early, look high through the turn, and keep throttle changes gentle. It is more satisfying to link ten clean bends than rescue one silly one.
sections.photoQuery: Externsteine rock sight Detmold ridge road Hannover / Lower Saxony escapes

sections.advice: Detmold ridge road → Lemgo old-town stop is shade riding: beautiful, cooler and sometimes slick. Expect damp patches, leaves, gravel and wildlife where the trees meet the road.
sections.photoQuery: Detmold ridge road Bad Iburg forest return Hannover / Lower Saxony escapes

sections.advice: Lemgo old-town stop → Back to Hannover is the reward section in Hannover. Look through the bends, use legal pull-offs for photos and keep a little margin for tractors, cyclists and damp shade. The best ride here is smooth, not noisy.
sections.photoQuery: Lemgo old-town stop Externsteine rock sight Hannover / Lower Saxony escapes

scenicChapters.title: Grand Tour of Switzerland
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 37 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

places-robenhausen-odenahlen.story: 315 km from Wetzikon to Wetzikon, about 5 h 26 of riding. The stops in between: Egelsee, Konstanz-Hinterhausen, Schreckensee and Ödenahlen. It crosses from Switzerland into Germany - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. The line favours views over speed.
